rootAssessment: Substantive assent to the exact reviewed D3b-0 r3, the rebase onto D3a-4 (4e475c7) of the accepted r2 (M3-D r5 items 4, 8, 16 and 18; D3b plan r3 sub-unit D3b-0, library only, platform mechanisms with no policy): child_processes over proc_listchildpids (a pid count) and group_members_bounded over proc_listpids(PROC_PGRP_ONLY) (bytes), each into one caller-sized buffer of capacity plus one slots, Exceeded when filled, never a truncated list, ListingCapacity when the buffer does not fit the call's int; process_identity over proc_pidinfo(PROC_PIDTBSDINFO), None for no such process and for a zombie; Child::kill_descendant on the owned child, refusing the root, pid 1 or a group pid, the host pid and any call after the reap before any read, then rereading the identity and sending SIGKILL only on an equal pid and start time, start times never compared for order (RF-4). group_members keeps its unbounded doubling until D3b-1 moves its callers to the bounded form (LD-D3B0-1; Q1 accepted); failed calls are Err(Io) with their call and errno (LD-D3B0-2; Q2 accepted). Round 2 (D3B0-R1-RF-1): both listings clear errno immediately before the libproc call, whose wrappers return 0 on failure, so zero with errno set is Io and zero with errno clear a real empty list; the one-byte ENOMEM controls and the stale-errno control pin it.
